edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Access refused without the right (exception X2)
    Given the role does not hold Treatment and offer U
    When the role calls the route operation
    Then the system refuses with 403 before any read or write and no record is written
    And the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC4 No change, nothing recorded (exception X3)
    Given the recompute finds no change to the picture
    When the step runs
    Then nothing is recorded, the reopen is not needed and the case state stays

  Scenario: AC5 Case not open, step refused (exception X4)
    Given the case is closed, cancelled, merged or in a legal hold
    When the step runs
    Then the step does not run, nothing is recorded and the state is reported to the parent

  Scenario: AC6 Stale ACE data product holds the step (exception X5)
    Given the ACE data product behind the payments or the appraisal is stale
    When the step runs
    Then the step holds, writes nothing and shows the data date with MSG-P1-001
    And it resumes on a fresh answer

  Scenario: AC7 Consumed service unavailable (exception X6)
    Given rwb-decision, rwb-deviation, rwb-case or rwb-source-data does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the step runs
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    And nothing is written and the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC8 Request invalid (exception X7)
    Given a required element of the request is absent or the reason code is not one of its list
    When the command is submitted
    Then 422 is returned before the step runs and no record is written
    And the user sees MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC9 Repeated command (exception X8)
    Given the same command is submitted twice with the same Idempotency-Key
    When the repeat arrives
    Then one record is written, one answer is given and the stored answer is returned
    And the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC10 Boundary held (exception X9)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, recovery_case, a deviation row or another service's schema
    When the build runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
    And nothing is released, no event is published and no name, address, contact value or identity number is written
